notes.title: The free Demo of "Arcana Academy" is now available!
notes.notes:
[p][/p][p][b]Thank you for waiting, players! Our developed game, “Arcana Academy”, now has a free demo available on Steam. Click the link below or search directly on Steam to download and try the Demo.[/b][/p][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3801300/_Demo/"][/dynamiclink][b]Steam search keyword: “Arcana Academy”[/b][/p][p][/p][p][b]We sincerely invite all players who love "Arcana Academy" to try out our demo and share your valuable feedback! Thank you for your support![/b][/p][p][b]Freely Construct your sacred Magic Earth, or let it become a cradle of corruption; Summon gifted Apprentices—whether they are knowledge-hungry Humans or noble and elegant children of the Forest. But beware, from classroom teachings to forbidden Rituals, every Select you make will determine the fate of the Academy... [/b][/p][p][b]In a world where magic and Cards intertwine, will you become the founder of the Legendary Academy, or a conspirator of the abyss? [/b][/p][p][b]This free demo includes the following content:[/b][/p][p][b]① \[Create from Scratch] Build your magical sanctuary > Personally construct your exclusive Magic Academy in a remote corner of the Earth! Freely design every Building and Facility, and watch your dream Magic Earth rise from the ground! [/b][/p][p][b]② \[Diverse Races] Apprentice development > Summon talented Apprentices such as Humans and Elves! Customize exclusive training plans and witness the epic journey as inexperienced Apprentices transform into Legendary Mages! [/b][/p][p][b]③ \[Unknown Ritual] Mysterious Exploration > Sneak into sealed magical forbidden zones! Personally concoct ancient potions and activate dangerous yet alluring mysterious Rituals—power and corruption are just a thought apart! [/b][/p][p][b]④ \[Epic Showdown] Academy Defense Battle > Assemble a powerful Mage legion! Fight against abyssal monsters, break Dark curses, and use devastating magic to protect your hard-earned magical pure Earth![/b][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45587739/bb9664eab8c184aa789b84e753f1ef98f3c5d85b.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Visit our Steam Page.[/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3612250/Arcana_Academy/"][/dynamiclink]Just under the short description (beneath the main banner), you’ll see a row of tags.[/p][p]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45587739/19de37d852fdb4cb20148731c1070eaeff19a1b9.png"][/img][/p][p]Click on all the tags that fit — we’ve added the most relevant ones already, but feel free to suggest more![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45587739/411d129cc3ed6ee89062f946d3236a76567e5330.png"][/img][/p][p]Why it matters:[/p][p]Steam uses tags to recommend games to players who are most likely to enjoy them. notes.title: Arcana Academy has participated in the Zombies vs Vampires Fest!
notes.notes:
Greetings, Arcana Academy is now participating in the Zombies vs. Vampires Game Festival. In this event filled with blood and shadows, we'll be unveiling a special Vampire Card feature!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45587739/d61dda90a54aa77a0498930d37bd85ecaf782334.png[/img]

As one of the Races available from the start, the Vampire Race boasts higher initial Attack and more powerful research abilities, but comes with lower HP. Conversely, in Battle, Vampires can restore HP by damaging enemies.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45587739/f0e1c13209d22ee6e85e6bdeb308ca10e317dd22.png[/img]

At the Academy, Vampires, like Students of other Races, can consume regular Food. However, they prefer blood or delicacies made with blood (and coffee). A steady supply of blood effectively increases the comfort of Vampires on campus, but may also nurture their darker side, affecting Class choices after Ritual advancement.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45587739/1441c77f168453dce2f99d8537b03dfa9a159ffe.png[/img]

Additionally, the Vampire Race's unique Buildings help them learn and research faster, ease their thirst for blood, and enhance the overall comfort of the Academy.

notes.title: Get Ready for the STEAM CREATURE COLLECTOR FEST!
notes.notes:
In the previous issue, we introduced some creature friends that can be summoned through Rituals;
In this issue, we'll showcase some different companions.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45587739/d72ee145c56081e30ea03bf347eca00d95b9184e.png[/img]
Many monsters in the game can be tamed using items like the Friend Potion. After joining the Academy, some of them can provide significant combat power to the Academy, while others offer unique abilities.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45587739/f0c638917557ccf6532f5e316d2d2553236c6243.png[/img]
Unlike Monsters, Glowing Sheep are not threatening (usually), so gathering them for herding is a good choice. They can produce animal fur and meat.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45587739/e688dabd8ec15ce574ef7e8a5346734312ee1a30.png[/img]
Slimes are a common type of creature with low threat; even a Novice who just enrolled can defeat them bare-handed. After joining the Academy, they can produce Slime Gel, which serves as material for synthesis or Rituals.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45587739/f31e93661502c9e945cf8e5f58fe175b8e284919.png[/img]
Bees can produce honey (naturally), but the power of Giant Bees should not be underestimated. When facing them, try not to fight alone.

Of course, this batch of Cards is still in development. If you have any creative ideas, please share them in our community~

notes.title: Get Ready for the STEAM CREATURE COLLECTOR FEST!
notes.notes:
As a magical Academy management sim, Arcana Academy is packed with all sorts of fantastic creatures for you to collect. Check out some of the magical friends you can discover through Rituals:
﻿﻿[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45587739/77e775e42ba00d5e0edd203a2795b67c861495fd.png[/img]
These companions can help out with work just like an apprentice, but some of them have even cooler abilities in special areas, like:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45587739/b06aea4967a8729fd4329cfe207daf9affabd2bf.png[/img]
﻿Owls are the top-rated mail carriers at the magical Academy. They’re pros at Summon and Explore, and can deliver letters right to every child dreaming of visiting the Academy.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45587739/f6a8c61c52c086a3dada1fbb8c999c939baf6136.png[/img]
﻿Cat Professor is a teaching expert. When the teachers or Headmaster are busy, this clever kitty often steps in to supervise the Students. (It can even sniff out cheaters!)
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45587739/b552f338ff8fb7a709bc2606e706c3e73763e749.png[/img]
﻿The hardworking octopus worker has eight arms. While it’s not great at delicate work, its mining skills are absolutely top-notch.

And that's just the beginning—more cards are in the works, so keep an eye out for our next reveals!

[b]The Arcana Academy store page is now live! Don’t forget to follow us and add Arcana Academy to your wishlist![/b]
